properties.source: 1例paxlovid与他克莫司药物相互作用导致患者血糖升高的药学监护_周炜.pdf
properties.raw_text: 由于paxlovid与他克莫司之间存在强药物相互作用，患者他克莫司血药浓度升高至43.6 ng/ml
properties.chunk_id: 1例paxlovid与他克莫司药物相互作用导致患者血糖升高的药学监护_周炜:7
properties.data: . 7 mmol/L，患者出现恶心呕吐等中毒症状。临床药师建议立即停用他克莫司，并每日监测血药浓度，待paxlovid使用疗程结束后3 d，且查看血药浓度情况后恢复使用。此后，他克莫司血药谷浓度逐步平稳，血糖恢复正常，患者恶心呕吐逐渐好转。Pharmaceutical monitoring of a patient with elevated level of blood glucose induced by paxlovid-tacrolimus drug interactions Zhou Wei，Jiang Junjie，Wang Facai（\* Department of Pharmacy，the Lu'an Hospital Affiliated to Anhui Medical University，Lu'an 237005，China） \*Corresponding author［Abstract］ A kidney transplant patient was complicated with COVID-19. Because of the long-term use of immuno-rejection drugs，such as tacrolimus and prednisone acetate，the patient's immunity was reduced. The patient's condition worsened drastically after admission. He was treated with antiviral therapy of nematrevir tablets and ritonavir tablets. However，due to the strong drug interaction between paxlovid and tacrolimus，the blood concentration of tacrolimus in the patient increased to 43. 6 ng/ml；
